coverage: Southern coast through Trondheim; includes Oslo, Stavanger, Bergen, Hardangervidda, Jotunheimen and the southern fjords. Mainland Norway and coastal islands only; excludes Svalbard and Jan Mayen. Adjacent editions overlap by 0.5 degrees latitude (approximately 56 km).
